tooltip.herbcraft_cuisine.hodgepodge: Looks like a bit of everything...
book.herbcraft_cuisine.entry.heard: You have heard of this dish, but never cooked it...
tooltip.herbcraft_cuisine.water_bowl.nat: Water tempers the herbs — suited for cuisine, not hodgepodge.
advancements.herbcraft_cuisine.water_bow: Hold water in a bowl: drink it, cook with it, soothe yourself briefly — but it does not repair long-term nutrition.
advancements.herbcraft_cuisine.first_dis: Eat a Herbcraft dish. Cuisine is not raw gambling; it makes preparation steadier.
advancements.herbcraft_cuisine.first_hod: Eat a Herbal Hodgepodge. A mixed bowl is quick, but its nature is harder to read.
advancements.herbcraft_cuisine.immunity_: Eat a medicinal meal that grants effect immunity. Food therapy prepares you; it is not just milk after the fact.
advancements.herbcraft_cuisine.hundred_f: Eat the Hundred-Flower Feast. A table of blossoms may also serve alchemy.
advancements.herbcraft_cuisine.deadly_ho: Eat the Deadly Hodgepodge. Poison, tamed with care, can still save a life.
book.herbcraft_cuisine.guide.cuisine.lin: Cuisine turns wild nature into preparation. The Cuisine chapter explains water bowls, medicinal dishes, and hodgepodge.
book.herbcraft_cuisine.guide.cuisine.wat: You know the water bowl: drink it, cook with it, soothe briefly, but it does not repair long-term nutrition.
book.herbcraft_cuisine.guide.cuisine.fir: You have eaten a medicinal dish. This overview only points the way; the Cuisine chapter holds the craft itself.
book.herbcraft_cuisine.guide.cuisine.hod: You have tasted hodgepodge: quick to make, harder to read.
book.herbcraft_cuisine.guide.cuisine.imm: You have seen food therapy immunity: preparation before trouble matters.
book.herbcraft_cuisine.guide.cuisine.non: If raw eating feels too risky, begin with a water bowl and a simple dish.
guide.herbcraft_cuisine.first_water_bowl: A water bowl can soothe you for a while and serves cuisine, but it does not truly repair nutrition.
guide.herbcraft_cuisine.first_dish: Cuisine is not raw gambling. Medicinal dishes are preparation: cleansing, immunity, and steadier nourishment.
book.herbcraft_cuisine.guide.overview.li: Cuisine does not gamble on a single raw bite; it turns wild nature into preparation.
The water bowl is the entry, medicinal dishes are the steady path, and hodgepodge is the quick path.
book.herbcraft_cuisine.guide.overview.no: If you do not know where to begin, try drawing water with an empty bowl.
book.herbcraft_cuisine.guide.overview.fi: You have eaten a medicinal dish: cooking can make wild nature steadier.
An empty bowl can hold water. A water bowl can be drunk, and often begins medicinal cooking.
You know the water bowl: it soothes briefly and enters recipes, but does not truly repair nutrition.
With a water bowl, many raw medicinal dishes can begin; after shaping them, heat finishes the meal.
book.herbcraft_cuisine.guide.dishes.line: Fixed dishes are about control. Compared with raw eating, they trade gamble for preparation.
book.herbcraft_cuisine.guide.dishes.unkn: Before any dish is recorded, remember only this: bowl and ingredients are the first doorway.
book.herbcraft_cuisine.guide.dishes.hear: You have heard of a dish; to truly know it, craft or eat it yourself.
book.herbcraft_cuisine.guide.dishes.wate: Some dishes need only a bowl and ingredients; some medicinal meals begin raw and are finished by heat.
book.herbcraft_cuisine.guide.dishes.firs: You have eaten a dish. Its ingredients, cleansing, and immunity lessons will slowly fill the Cuisine chapter.
Hodgepodge is quick to make and harder to read. Many herbs in one bowl may help or clash.
An empty bowl can make hodgepodge; a water bowl cannot. Red and brown mushrooms remain vanilla suspicious stew.
You have tasted hodgepodge: it gathers ingredient natures, but may serve their conflicts too.
book.herbcraft_cuisine.guide.immunity.li: Milk cleans up after the fact; medicinal cuisine prepares before trouble.
book.herbcraft_cuisine.guide.immunity.af: Not every dish grants immunity. To know one, see what it clears and what it keeps away.
book.herbcraft_cuisine.guide.immunity.kn: You have seen food therapy immunity: some dishes do not only cleanse, but hold the same harm back for a time.
book.herbcraft_cuisine.guide.hidden_cata: A few dishes seem to be more than food. If the Alchemy chapter is installed, extreme meals may even become alchemical catalysts.
This page records rumor, not recipe. If such a dish exists, pages, practice, and heat must lead you there; alchemy linkage needs the Alchemy chapter present.
You have seen the Hundred-Flower Feast: many blossoms together can push clean medicine to its height.
You have seen the Deadly Hodgepodge: toxin, tamed with care, can become a catalyst in the Alchemy chapter.
